title: Engineering a light-active CoO/D-CN catalyst for dual-functional enhanced BPA degradation and hydrogen evolution
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46737-46748
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05595D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sudhansu Sekhar Behera, Alaka Samal, Arundhati Barik, Nigamananda Das
The CoO/D-CN Z-scheme heterojunction exhibits superior photocatalytic performance for H2 evolution and BPA degradation under visible light illumination, attributed to enhanced charge separation and active heterojunction interface sites.
